newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: TENNIS-NOVOTNA WIN LEAVES CZECHS LEVEL WITH DUTCH.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-NOVOTNA WIN LEAVES CZECHS LEVEL WITH DUTCH.

text.p: Wimbledon finalist Jana Novotna shrugged off a muscle injury and overwhelmed Miriam Oremans of the Netherlands 6-3 6-0 to leave the Czech Republic level after the first day of their Fed Cup semifinal on Saturday.
"My doctors recommended after Wimbledon I take three weeks off but I new how much our team needed me," said the world number two.
The Dutch had gone ahead in the opening singles when Brenda Schultz-McCarthy beat Czech debutante Sandra Kleinova 6-1 7-6.
Schultz-McCarthy, ranked 14th in the world, won six games in succession to take the first set.
Kleinova, aged 19 and playing for the national side for the first time, provided more resistance in the second but said the Dutch player's serve had proved decisive.
"I apologise, I just couldn't make it," said the 50th-ranked Kleinova.
